Package restaurantrush.entity

Class Restaurant

java.lang.Object
restaurantrush.entity.Restaurant
public class Restaurant extends Object
The restaurant floor: the menu, the tables, the waiting queue, every customer who has arrived and every order taken.

It creates its own tables and makes sure the queue, tables, customers and orders stay in sync. Staff use its methods to seat customers, create orders and take payments.
